about.title: Behind the Needles & Gears
about.subtitle: Kesarganj, Ajmer ke dil me basi ek family-run shop. 30 saalon se hum tailor bhaiyon, boutique chalane wali behno aur har ghar ke stitching dreams ko support kar rahe hain.
about.storyTitle: Corner Wali Wo Chhoti Si Shop
about.storyP1: Humne 1995 me sirf ek simple metal toolbox, thodi garam meethi chai aur ek pakke vaade ke saath kaam shuru kiya tha: ki har customer ki machine ko apni samajh kar theek karenge. Tab Kesarganj me traditional dardi tailors ka bada hub tha. Jab bhi unki manual hand-crank machine stuck hoti, hum haazir rehte the.
about.storyP2: Ajmer ke saath hum bhi aage badhe, par humne kabhi cold corporate style nahi apnaya. Hamare liye sewing machine sirf steel aur motor nahi hai; ye ek ghar ki roti, bacchon ki education aur unki self-respect ka sahara hai. Simple domestic machine ho ya modern digital automatic system, hum apna 100% effort dete hain.
about.storyP3: Aaj hume proud hai ki poore Ajmer district, Kishangarh, Beawar aur Nasirabad ke tailors hum par ankh band karke trust karte hain. No fancy contracts, bas ek pyari smile, chai ki chuski aur dilon ka rishta.
about.ownerQuote: "Sewing machine sirf do cheezein maangti hai: acche oil ki ek boond aur sachha respect. Agar aap dono denge, to ye life-time bina ek bhi tanka chhore chalegi."
about.ownerBio: Dinesh ji ne bachpan se hi mechanical machines repair karna seekha tha. Aaj, 30+ years ke solid experience ke saath, wo machine ki sound sunkar hi bata dete hain ki gear me problem hai ya shuttle me dust hai. Har major servicing wo khud apni dekh-rekh me karte hain aur perfection check karke hi deliver karte hain.
about.missionDesc: Kisi bhi dardi ya boutique owner ka kaam technical issue ki wajah se na ruke. Hum bilkul honest rates me original parts lagakar lifetime support dete hain taki sab izzat se kaam kar sakein.
about.visionDesc: Ajmer ke tailors ko modern energy-saving motors aur electronic systems operate karna sikhana, taki unka kaam aasan, fast aur jyada profit dene wala ho sake.
about.trustReason1Desc: Agar machine me sirf ek basic cleaning aur oiling ki zarurat hai, to hum kabhi fuzool me naya part daalne ka extra charge nahi lagate. Sab clear aur honest batate hain.
about.trustReason2Desc: Hum sirf trusted brands ke certified original needles, bobbin cases aur shuttle hooks hi rakhte hain jo machine ki life badhate hain. Duplicate parts hum strictly avoid karte hain.
about.trustReason3Desc: Wedding aur festival season me tailors ka time kitna costly hota hai hum samajhte hain. Urgent case me hum extra time dekar machine same day deliver karte hain.
about.trustReason4Desc: Relationship bill payment pe khatam nahi hota. Minor issue ho to shop par aao, chai piyo aur bina kisi tension ke machine ki tuning karwao.
about.workshopPhotosSub: Hamari workshop ki sachhi tasveerein — jahan wrenches, grease, machines aur solid mechanical knowledge ka mel hota hai.
about.timelineSub: Ek chhote toolbag se lekar Ajmer ki sabse trusted sewing machine shop banne tak ki short timeline.
about.t1995Desc: Dinesh ji ne bicycle aur ek steel tool-box ke saath kaam shuru kiya, tailors ki dukaano pe ja kar immediate service dete the.
about.t2002Desc: Ajmer ke heart Kesarganj me physical showroom khula, jisse local log original brands direct and trusted rate pe lene lage.
about.t2012Desc: Boutique industry ke badhte trends ke sath digital power-saving servo motors aur automatic tables ki setting shuru ki.
about.t2020Desc: Computerized embroidery machines setup karke local boutique workers ko training dena aur design loads sikhana shuru kiya.
about.tTodayDesc: Aaj bhi wahi same tea, same honest and friendly advice aur same best local rates ke sath hum tailors ko serve kar rahe hain.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: New machines kharidne, repair rates aur home services se jude common sawaal-jawaab.

items.q: Kya aap Ajmer mein sewing machine home repair service dete hain?
items.a: Haan! Hum pure Kesarganj aur Ajmer city ke sabhi major areas me doorstep home repair service dete hain. Jarurat padne par pick-and-drop ki suvidha bhi hai.

items.q: Aap kis brands ki sifting machines bechte hain?
items.a: Hum USHA, SINGER, JACK, BROTHER aur MERRITT ke authorized partners hain. Aapko full brand warranty ke sath original brand new machines milti hain.

items.q: Kya repairing ke time original spare parts hi use hote hain?
items.a: Ji haan! Hum sirf 100% genuine aur original authorized spare parts (sewing motors, needle bar, gears, shuttle) hi use karte hain taaki machine smooth chale.

items.q: Kya repairing ke baad koi service warranty milti hai?
items.a: Bilkul! Hum repairs par 30-day ki workshop service warranty dete hain. Agar wahi issue same parts me aata hai, toh bina kisi charge ke service di jati hai.

items.q: Kya aap computerized embroidery machine ka demo class bhi dete hain?
items.a: Haan! Jab bhi aap computerized zigzag ya embroidery machine kharidte hain, toh hum ghar par installation ke sath-sath live operate karne ka demo free of cost dete hain.
